course.Title: CSS Introduction
course.description: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) styles HTML elements. It controls layout, colors, fonts, and responsive design.

course.Title: CSS Syntax
course.description: CSS rules consist of a selector and declaration block. Each declaration has a property and value.

course.Title: CSS Selectors
course.description: Selectors target HTML elements for styling. Types include element, class, id, and attribute selectors.

course.Title: CSS Comments
course.description: Comments are ignored by browsers and are used to document CSS code.

course.Title: CSS Colors
course.description: Colors can be specified by name, RGB, HEX, HSL, or HSV.

course.Title: CSS Backgrounds
course.description: Background properties control the background color and image of an element.

course.Title: CSS Borders
course.description: Borders define the edge of an element with style, width, and color.

course.Title: CSS Margins
course.description: Margins create space outside an element, between the element and other elements.

course.Title: CSS Padding
course.description: Padding creates space inside an element, between content and border.

course.Title: CSS Box Model
course.description: The box model consists of content, padding, border, and margin layers.

course.Title: CSS Width and Height
course.description: Width and height set element dimensions in pixels, percentages, or other units.

course.Title: CSS Text
course.description: Text properties control font, size, color, alignment, and spacing.

course.Title: CSS Fonts
course.description: Font selection includes system fonts and web fonts imported via @font-face or Google Fonts.

course.Title: CSS Links
course.description: Links have four pseudo-class states that can be styled separately.

course.Title: CSS Lists
course.description: List style properties customize bullet points and numbering.

course.Title: CSS Display
course.description: Display property controls how an element is rendered (block, inline, inline-block, flex, grid, none).

course.Title: CSS Positioning
course.description: Position property controls element placement (static, relative, absolute, fixed, sticky).

course.Title: CSS Overflow
course.description: Overflow property controls content that exceeds the element boundaries.

course.Title: CSS Float
course.description: Float property wraps text around floated elements. Mostly replaced by flexbox/grid.

course.Title: CSS Flexbox
course.description: Flexbox is a layout model that aligns and distributes space among items in a container.

course.Title: CSS Grid
course.description: CSS Grid creates a 2D layout with rows and columns.

course.Title: CSS Alignment
course.description: Text and item alignment properties for precise positioning.

course.Title: CSS Opacity
course.description: Opacity controls transparency of an element from 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque).

course.Title: CSS Transforms
course.description: Transform property rotates, scales, skews, or translates elements in 2D or 3D.

course.Title: CSS Transitions
course.description: Transitions smoothly animate CSS property changes over time.

course.Title: CSS Animations
course.description: Animations create complex motion using keyframes, independent of user interaction.

course.Title: CSS Media Queries
course.description: Media queries apply styles based on device characteristics like screen size.

course.Title: CSS Responsive Design
course.description: Responsive design makes websites look good on all screen sizes and devices.

course.Title: CSS Variables
course.description: CSS custom properties (variables) store reusable values.

course.Title: CSS Pseudo-classes
course.description: Pseudo-classes target elements in specific states or positions.

course.Title: CSS Pseudo-elements
course.description: Pseudo-elements style specific parts of elements or insert content.

course.Title: CSS Gradients
course.description: Gradients create smooth color transitions as backgrounds.

course.Title: CSS Filters
course.description: Filters apply visual effects like blur, brightness, and saturation.

course.Title: CSS Box Shadow
course.description: Box shadow adds shadows around an element.

course.Title: CSS Text Shadow
course.description: Text shadow adds shadows to text content.

course.Title: CSS Print Styles
course.description: Print media queries optimize styles for printing.

course.Title: CSS Columns
course.description: Column properties create multi-column layouts for text.

course.Title: CSS Shape Outside
course.description: Shape-outside wraps text around non-rectangular shapes.

course.Title: CSS Clipping
course.description: Clip-path masks elements to specific shapes.

course.Title: CSS Stacking Context
course.description: Z-index controls the stacking order of overlapping elements.
